note: Triennial election of Kilkeel rural district council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964 where contested. Sixteen divisions (Greencastle no longer listed); fourteen had a single candidate after withdrawals and disqualifications (Lisnacree and Dunnaman among them, Newry Telegraph, 23 May 1964, p. 13). Attical and Maghera were polled; their results are recorded from the Irish News, 5 June 1964, p. 1. No valid nomination: Mr. James Walsh, the sitting member, 'would have been returned unopposed', but an error in completing his paper disqualified him; 'as there was no other candidate in opposition, he retains the seat' (Newry Telegraph, 23 May 1964, p. 13, 'In again - out again - in again', page image). Recorded as returned without a poll. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
